IF D23581100-14, SEE D23581300-14: THE FOLLOWING GEAR & A/C CONFIGURATIONS ARE POSSIBLE: A = POST MOD 43435 & PRE MOD 56814 & 58794 (OVSTEER WARNING SYSTEM ACTIVE). B = SBS 32-3234/32-4276 EMBODIED ON NLG (OVSTEER WARNING SYSTEM DE-ACTIVATED). C = MOD 58794 EMBODIED ON NLG & PRE MOD 201082 (OVSTEER WARNING SYSTEM REMOVED IN PRODUCTION) OR PRE MOD 43435. THE OPTIONS FOR REPLACEMENT OF GEAR DURING AOG SITUATIONS & THE ACTIONS RQRD TO AVOID CONFIG ISSUES ARE: A TO B; 2-WAY ICY ONLY WHEN SB 32-3234 OR 32-4276 IS EMBODIED ON THE A/C & PROVIDED THAT NLG LEG & ELEC BOX ARE REPLACED TOGETHER. B TO A; 2-WAY ICY ONLY WHEN SB 32-3234 OR 32-4276 IS EMBODIED ON THE REPLACEMENT GEAR & PROVIDED THAT NLG LEG & ELEC BOX ARE REPLACED TOGETHER. B TO B; NONE. NOTE: REMAINING CONFIGS (A TO A, A TO C, B TO C, C TO A, C TO B & C TO C) ARE COVERED IN MP-H16032. IT MUST BE NOTED THAT ALTHOUGH THE DEACTIVATION OF THE OVERSTEER WARNING SYSTEM DOES NOT INVOLVE THE MOD OR REMOVAL OF ANY PART INCLUDED IN THE ALS PART 1, NEW RNLG PNRS ARE RQRD MEANING THAT THE ALS PART 1 IS AFFECTED. REINFORCED NLG D23581300 & WBS REINFORCED NLG D23581350. THERE ARE NO CHANGES TO EITHER THE FATIGUE LIVES OR PNRS OF ANY PSE PARTS LISTED IN ALS PART 1. TWO RELAYS (5GH & 7GH) WILL BE DISCONNECTED TO DISABLE THE 8GH BOX. A TECHNICAL REPORT DESCRIBING THE PRINCIPLE BEHIND THE DEACTIVATION IS AVAILABLE (SCF/SYS/P/09/58240). IF F5755050520000, SEE F5755565900051: MODIFICATION 46720 (H13777) INTRODUCED A REVISED AILERON ACTUATOR SEAL DESIGN CONFIGURED AS A ONE PIECE ITEM REPLACING EARLIER AILERON ACTUATOR MULTIPLE FINGER SEAL ASSEMBLIES. CONCURRENTLY, THE AILERON BLADE SEALS WHICH ARE FITTED ADJACENT TO THE ACTUATOR SEALS, WERE ALSO MODIFIED BY LENGTHENING THE SEAL TO CORRECTLY FIT AGAINST THE NEW ACTUATOR SEALS. SHOULD AN OPERATOR OF A PRE MOD 46720 AIRCRAFT NEED TO ORDER EITHER A COMPLETE FINGER SEAL ASSEMBLY OR AN INDIVIDUAL FINGER SEAL, A POST MOD 46720 ONE PIECE SEAL CAN BE FITTED WITH THE EXISTING AILERON BLADE SEALS. NOTE, IF A PRE MOD 46720 CLOSING FINGER OR CENTRAL FINGER IS REQUIRED, THEN REFERENCE TO THE SPECIFIC FINGER SEAL ASSEMBLY IS REQUIRED IN ORDER TO ENABLE SUPPLY OF THE CORRECT POST MOD 46720 SEAL ASSEMBLY. THE PREFERRED, BUT NOT MANDATORY SOLUTION WOULD BE TO REPLACE THE PRE MOD 46720 FINGER SEALS AND BLADE SEALS WITH A COMPLETE SET OF POST MOD ONE PIECE ACTUATOR AND ADJACENT BLADE SEALS (3 BLADE SEALS AND 2 ACTUATOR SEALS PER AILERON).

SHOULD AN OPERATOR OF A PRE MOD 46720 AIRCRAFT NEED TO ORDER EITHER A COMPLETE FINGER SEAL ASSEMBLY OR AN INDIVIDUAL FINGER SEAL, A POST MOD 46720 ONE PIECE SEAL CAN BE FITTED WITH THE EXISTING AILERON BLADE SEALS. NOTE, IF A PRE MOD 46720 CLOSING FINGER OR CENTRAL FINGER IS REQUIRED, THEN REFERENCE TO THE SPECIFIC FINGER SEAL ASSEMBLY IS REQUIRED IN ORDER TO ENABLE SUPPLY OF THE CORRECT POST MOD 46720 SEAL ASSEMBLY. THE PREFERRED, BUT NOT MANDATORY SOLUTION WOULD BE TO REPLACE THE PRE MOD 46720 FINGER SEALS AND BLADE SEALS WITH A COMPLETE SET OF POST MOD ONE PIECE ACTUATOR AND ADJACENT BLADE SEALS (3 BLADE SEALS AND 2 ACTUATOR SEALS PER AILERON).

SHOULD AN OPERATOR OF A PRE MOD 46720 AIRCRAFT NEED TO ORDER EITHER A COMPLETE FINGER SEAL ASSEMBLY OR AN INDIVIDUAL FINGER SEAL, A POST MOD 46720 ONE PIECE SEAL CAN BE FITTED WITH THE EXISTING AILERON BLADE SEALS. NOTE, IF A PRE MOD 46720 CLOSING FINGER OR CENTRAL FINGER IS REQUIRED, THEN REFERENCE TO THE SPECIFIC FINGER SEAL ASSEMBLY IS REQUIRED IN ORDER TO ENABLE SUPPLY OF THE CORRECT POST MOD 46720 SEAL ASSEMBLY. THE PREFERRED, BUT NOT MANDATORY SOLUTION WOULD BE TO REPLACE THE PRE MOD 46720 FINGER SEALS AND BLADE SEALS WITH A COMPLETE SET OF POST MOD ONE PIECE ACTUATOR AND ADJACENT BLADE SEALS (3 BLADE SEALS AND 2 ACTUATOR SEALS PER AILERON).

PN F53132310001 CAN REPLACE PN F53132310000 UNDER CONDITIONS(A). PN F53132310000 CAN REPLACE PN F53132310001 UNDER CONDITIONS(B). (A) IF THE A/C IS NOT FITTED WITH FOMAX AND FOMAX ANTENNAS UNDER THE RADOME (MOD 208363/S34847 NOT INSTALLED), THEN INSTALL AN AIRWORTHY CAP ON ALL ANTENNA CONNECTORS AS IT IS SAID IN THE SB INFORMATION SYSTEM-FLIGHT OPERATION PERIPHERALS-INSTALL ANTENNAS ON  RADOME FOR FOMAX #A330-46-3162. IN THE TASK A330-A-46-XX-3162-01000-93AA-A AND SUBTASK A330-A-46-XX-3162-02001-720A-A. NOTE: IN CASE OF LIGHTNING STRIKE ON THE RADOME, THE INSPECTION TASK MUST CHECK THAT THE CONNECTOR CAP IS STILL IN PLACE. IF THE A/C IS FITTED WITH FOMAX AND FOMAX ANTENNAS UNDER THE RADOME (MOD 208363/S34847 INSTALLED), THEN: -CONNECT THE FOMAX ANTENNAS UNDER RADOME. -RE-ACTIVATE THE FOMAX AS PER MAINTENANCE TASK. (B) IF THE A/C IS FITTED WITH FOMAX AND FOMAX ANTENNAS UNDER THE RADOME (MOD 208363/S34847 INSTALLED), THEN: -DE-ACTIVATE THE FOMAX AS PER MAINTENANCE TASK. -ON A/C SIDE, PROTECT AND ATTACH OF THE MOBILE COAX CONNECTOR AS PER AIPS 07-01-001. ON THE REMOVED RADOME-ANTENNA, PROTECT THE ANTENNA CONNECTOR WITH A CAP.

MODIFICATION 46720 (H13777) INTRODUCED A REVISED AILERON ACTUATOR SEAL DESIGN CONFIGURED AS A ONE PIECE ITEM REPLACING EARLIER AILERON ACTUATOR MULTIPLE FINGER SEAL ASSEMBLIES. CONCURRENTLY, THE AILERON BLADE SEALS WHICH ARE FITTED ADJACENT TO THE ACTUATOR SEALS, WERE ALSO MODIFIED BY LENGTHENING THE SEAL TO CORRECTLY FIT AGAINST THE NEW ACTUATOR SEALS. SHOULD AN OPERATOR OF A PRE MOD 46720 AIRCRAFT NEED TO ORDER EITHER A COMPLETE FINGER SEAL ASSEMBLY OR AN INDIVIDUAL FINGER SEAL, A POST MOD 46720 ONE PIECE SEAL CAN BE FITTED WITH THE EXISTING AILERON BLADE SEALS. NOTE, IF A PRE MOD 46720 CLOSING FINGER OR CENTRAL FINGER IS REQUIRED, THEN REFERENCE TO THE SPECIFIC FINGER SEAL ASSEMBLY IS REQUIRED IN ORDER TO ENABLE SUPPLY OF THE CORRECT POST MOD 46720 SEAL ASSEMBLY. THE PREFERRED, BUT NOT MANDATORY SOLUTION WOULD BE TO REPLACE THE PRE MOD 46720 FINGER SEALS AND BLADE SEALS WITH A COMPLETE SET OF POST MOD ONE PIECE ACTUATOR AND ADJACENT BLADE SEALS (3 BLADE SEALS AND 2 ACTUATOR SEALS PER AILERON).

CONDITION A: TWO OPERATIONAL LIMITATIONS APPLY: 1. IT IS NOT ALLOWED TO FLY: - NORTH OF 60°N, BETWEEN 30°W AND 160°W, AND - NORTH OF 75°N, AND - SOUTH OF 55°S THESE EXCLUSION AREAS ARE DEFINED IN THE AFM AND FCOM LIMITATIONS. 2. MAGVAR OPERATIONAL LIMITATION LISTED IN FOT 999.0052/20 APPLIES, CONSIDERING ADIRU HAVING THE OLDEST MAGVAR TABLE. CONDITION A1: WHEN FMS STANDARD IS HWL PEGASUS P1 OR H2, ADIRU MIXABILITY IS NOT ALLOWED IN THE FOLLOWING EXCLUSION AREA: - NORTH OF 70°N, BETWEEN 180°W AND 160°W CONDITION A2: ON AIRCRAFT, AT LEAST 2 ADIRU MUST HAVE THE SAME PART NUMBER (E.G. 2 X 465020-03030318 AND 1 X 465020-03030319).

THE NEW STANDARD FQIC (P/N SIC 5059-13-10) IS ONE-WAY INTERCHANGEABLE, BUT TWO-WAY INTERCHANGEABLE WITH CONDITIONS WITH ALL OF THE FOLLOWING OLD FQIC UNITS: -SIC 5059-11-01-07;SIC 5059-11-0207; SIC 5059-12-0308; SIC5059-13-9; -SIC 5059-04-0104; SIC 5059-04-0105; SIC 5059-04-0106; SIC 5059-04-0107; -SIC 5059-04-0205; SIC 5059-04-0206; SIC5059-04-0207; SIC 5059-03-0104; -SIC 5059-03-0105; SIC 5059-03-0106; SIC 5059-03-0107; SIC 5059-03-0205; -SIC 5059-03-0206; SIC5059-03-0207. <U>ICY CONDITIONS RELATED TO FUEL LEAK DETECTION:</> ON A318/A319/A320 A/C WITH FUEL LEAK DETECTION FUNCTION ENABLED (MOD 32650, MP J2360), THIS FQIC STANDARD (SIC5059-13-10) MUST BE INSTALLED. IF THIS STANDARD OF FQIC IS NOT INSTALLED THEN THE FUEL LEAK DETECTION FUNCTION WILL BE LOST. THEREFORE, ON A/C WITH THIS STANDARD OF FQIC, IT IS ONE-WAY INTERCHANGEABLE. <U>ICY CONDITIONS RELATED TO ACTS:</> ON A319CJ AND A319/A320 FITTED WITH ACTS, ONLY SIC5059-12-0308 CAN REPLACE THE NEW FQIC STANDARD (SIC5059-13-10). <U>ICY CONDITIONS RELATED TO A318:</> ON A318 A/C, ONLY SIC5059-11-0207 CAN REPLACE THE NEW FQIC. <U>ICY CONDITIONS RELATED TO DRY BAY DELETION:</> IF A/C EMBODY DRY BAY DELETION MODIFICATIONS THE NEW FQIC CANNOT BE REPLACED BY ANY OF THE OLD FQIC STANDARDS. <U>CONCLUSION:</> THE NEW STANDARD FQIC IS THEREFORE ONE-WAY INTERCHANGEABLE WITH CONDITIONAL TWO WAY INTERCHANGEABILITY FOR ALL A/C TYPES, AS STATED IN THE ABOVE PARAGRAPHS.

THE FQIC 14-10 STD IS FULLY 2-WAY INTERCHANGEABLE WITH THE FQIC 13-10 STD. HOWEVER, IT MUST BE NOTED THAT CERTAIN OPERATIONAL REQUIREMENTS SHALL NECESSITATE THE INSTALLATION OF A MINIMUM STD FQIC. IT WAS REPLACED BY FQIC STD SIC5059-13-10 FOR ALL APPLICABLE A/C. ICY CONDITIONS RELATED TO FUEL LEAK DETECTION: ON A318 / A319 / A320 A/C, TO ENABLE THE FUEL LEAK DETECTION FUNCTION INTRODUCED BY MOD 32650 (J2360) TO BE OPERATIONAL, THE MINIMUM STD OF A/C FLIGHT WARNING COMPUTER (FWC) H2-F1C SHALL BE INSTALLED. HOWEVER, THE SOFTWARE UPGRADE INSTALLED ON FWC STD H2F2, INTRODUCED BY MOD 33374 (P8274), WHICH ALSO INCLUDES THE CA PABILITY OF FUEL LEAK DETECTION, SHALL BE A MANDATORY FLEET-WIDE IN-SERVICE RETROFIT OVER THE NEXT 3 YEARS.
